# BlackRock

> BlackRock is a global investment management and financial services company offering portfolio management platforms, ETFs, mutual funds, and institutional solutions to individual investors, financial advisors, and institutional clients worldwide.

BlackRock serves multiple investor segments through regional portals and specialized platforms. The company's core offerings include iShares ETFs, Aladdin enterprise software for institutional portfolio management, and comprehensive investment tools for retail and professional investors across 15+ countries.

## Key Topics

- BlackRock
- iShares
- Aladdin
- Investment Management
- Asset Management
- Portfolio Management

## Core Platforms & Solutions

- [BlackRock Corporate Website](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate): BlackRock corporate homepage with company information, investor relations, and leadership details.
- [Aladdin by BlackRock](https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin): Aladdin enterprise software platform for portfolio and risk management for institutional investors.
- [Institutional US Homepage](https://www.blackrock.com/institutions/en-us): Institutional investor portal offering investment insights and Aladdin platform solutions.

## Individual & Retail Investors

- [Investment Management for Individual Investors](https://www.blackrock.com/us/individual): BlackRock's main portal for individual investors offering iShares, mutual funds, and account management.
- [Advisor Center for US Financial Professionals](https://www.blackrock.com/us/financial-professionals): Resource center for US financial advisors with tools, insights, and educational courses.

## North American Regions

- [BlackRock Canada](https://www.blackrock.com/ca): BlackRock Canada financial planning and ETF investment management platform.
- [BlackRock Americas Offshore](https://www.blackrock.com/americas-offshore): BlackRock Americas offshore investing platform for international financial services.

## Asia-Pacific Regions

- [BlackRock China](https://www.blackrock.com/cn): BlackRock China offshore investment platform with iShares ETF and mutual funds.
- [BlackRock Australia](https://www.blackrock.com/au): BlackRock Australia regional site with adviser resources and investment tools.

## Latin America Regions

- [BlackRock Brasil](https://www.blackrock.com/br): BlackRock Brasil asset management and investment services portal.
- [BlackRock Chile](https://www.blackrock.com/cl): BlackRock Chile investment management and financial services portal.
- [BlackRock Colombia](https://www.blackrock.com/co): BlackRock Colombia investment management and financial services portal.

## Europe & Middle East Regions

- [BlackRock Austria](https://www.blackrock.com/at): BlackRock Austria wealth management and financial services portal.
- [BlackRock Belgium](https://www.blackrock.com/be): BlackRock Belgium investment management and financial services in Dutch.
- [BlackRock Czech Republic](https://www.blackrock.com/cz): BlackRock Czech Republic investment management with MiFID II compliance.
- [BlackRock Denmark](https://www.blackrock.com/dk): BlackRock Denmark financial planning and investment management services.
- [BlackRock Finland](https://www.blackrock.com/fi): BlackRock Finland financial planning and investment management platform.
- [BlackRock Dubai](https://www.blackrock.com/ae): BlackRock Dubai regional hub for investment management and wealth services.
